mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS id, t.ticket_order_id AS ticket_order_id, o.order_number AS order_number, t.status AS status, t.expires_at AS expires_at FROM ticket_access_tokens t JOIN ticket_orders o ON o.id = t.ticket_order_id WHERE t.token_hash = #{tokenHash}

SELECT it.id AS issued_ticket_id, it.ticket_code AS ticket_code, it.status AS status, it.checked_in_at AS checked_in_at, e.title AS expo_title, e.event_start_at AS expo_start_at, e.event_end_at AS expo_end_at FROM issued_tickets it JOIN ticket_order_items oi ON oi.id = it.ticket_order_item_id JOIN expos e ON e.id = it.expo_id WHERE oi.ticket_order_id = #{ticketOrderId} ORDER BY it.id
